gap: Forecast value and runtime of bounded online backtracking: test whether a moderately larger local solve with nonlinear step validation improves prequential prediction against adopted v6.
scope: One v6-based online optimizer candidate: fixed 16 PCG iterations and a bounded first-acceptable backtracking ladder. Unchanged model equations, inference, initialization, measured RMS curvature prior, scalar strength, residual objective, conditioning, preconditioner, forecast trust radius, observation/cache budgets and damping/rollback rules. No controller, plant collection, parameter sweep or consumer tuning option.

candidate.engine: Unchanged VehicleSequenceModel shared rigid-body formulation; arbitrary ordered command dimension.
candidate.interface: OnlineFit(prefix), predict(past_states,past_inputs,future_inputs), observe(index,issued_command,next_observation), save/load. index is the absolute source row of the issued command, equal to the current cursor; no gaps/replay.
candidate.prefix: One contiguous segment; retain 0.5 s observed context and the last 0.25 s completed transitions. Initialize using each of those transitions as a one-step ridge window; at least three windows. No padded history.
candidate.bootstrap: Unchanged initialization and fixed group loss scale, exactly matching v6 initial arrays. Same two ridge solves and no reinitialization.
candidate.batch_allocation: Entire bounded bootstrap and recent caches, equal weight to each role and equal weight to each actual window within each role. Fixed32 slots per role duplicate real windows under zero masks when unfilled; no synthetic observations or targets.
candidate.optimizer: One damped matrix-free proposal per valid observation. Run exactly 16 scheduled safeguarded PCG iterations from zero with the unchanged v6 A, group radial IRLS and M=A+damping; no restart, residual replacement, extra solve, changed damping or relinearization within the observation. Sixteen is an explicit engineering compute budget, not convergence or a proven optimum.
candidate.objective: Unchanged v6 equal-role, equal-time, equal-physical-group radial Huber recursive forecast loss plus the v6 measured-RMS-domain explicit quadratic-head curvature prior. A stays fixed through the solve and all step trials. All parameters remain trainable. Combined improvement may sacrifice data fit.
candidate.parameters: Same shared dynamics and all existing learned parameters; no new model head, platform branch, consumer option, inference integrator or persistent stream-sized array.
candidate.precision: float64 initialization and optimizer; float32 ambient prediction matching maintained default inference. Record actual runtime.
candidate.trust_rule: Compute the existing v6 forecast-only radius=max(1,0.5*norm(sqrt(W)*raw)) and clip the 16-PCG direction once. For each alpha in [1,1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16], evaluate theta+alpha*delta. Predicted reduction=-alpha*g.dot(delta)-0.5*alpha^2*(sum(W*IRLS*(Jdelta)^2)+delta.dot(A*delta)); damping excluded. Stop at the first finite eligible trial with trial_loss<current_loss, predicted>0 and gain=(current-trial)/predicted>=0.1. No best-of-ladder selection, original-four fallback or additional search. If none passes, reject the entire update, retaining original parameters and normalizers. Damping starts1, multiplies4 on rejection or accepted gain<.25, halves on accepted gain>.75, clips[1e-8,1e8], exactly once after the final decision.

conditioning.timing: One bounded pass after revealing each valid target and constructing the new full replay cache, before the unchanged Gauss-Newton proposal. No conditioning before the current prediction.
conditioning.measured_sequence: For each cache window concatenate past_states with future_states excluding the final target, and past_inputs with future_inputs. Filter this issued sequence using current learned tau and the existing initial-filter convention. Compute current_features on these observed states, without predicted states or simulator data.
conditioning.feature_rms: For every time t >= delay, concatenate current features and the delay ordered past-minus-current feature differences. Compute uncentered RMS with equal bootstrap/recent role weight, equal actual-window weight within each role, and equal eligible-time weight. The final 8 hidden feature scales remain unchanged at 1 because tanh memory has known bounds; no hidden-state traversal is added. Quadratic RMS uses current upper-triangle products at the same eligible times.
conditioning.output_rms: Compute each completed future one-step secant: R_t.T @ ((v_next-v_t)/dt - gravity) and (omega_next-omega_t)/dt. Use uncentered RMS, equal role/window weights and equal horizon-step weights. Use observed R_t, never simulator derivatives.
conditioning.scale_rule: For each of the three allowed normalizer arrays, new_scale = max(old_scale, causal_RMS) elementwise; no shrinking, new center, empirical floor, user knob or vehicle branch.
conditioning.compensation: Let sf=new_feature/old_feature, sq=new_quadratic/old_quadratic and so=old_output/new_output. Set linear=sf[:,None]*linear*so[None,:], quadratic=sq[:,None]*quadratic*so[None,:], bias=bias*so, w2=w2*so[None,:], w1=sf[:,None]*w1, memory=sf[:,None]*memory. Leave b1, memory_bias and raw_tau unchanged. This algebra preserves the full recurrent prediction function and command derivatives before optimization.
conditioning.acceptance: Use reconditioned parameters/normalizers for the 16-CG proposal and backtracking. Conditioning validity is an input to the private proposal acceptance guard; invalid conditioning disables all five trials. Commit conditioned normalizers only with the final accepted finite proposal. Otherwise retain the complete original model, consume valid data once, and update damping under the unchanged rule.
conditioning.accounting: Exactly one conditioning pass and one gradient/linearization per valid observation, 16 scheduled CG/curvature calls and 1 current objective plus N actual trial objectives, with N in1..5. Existing objective_calls therefore increments1+N; it is not a count of every internal inference/derivative operation.

loss_scale.data: Fixed bootstrap windows only, unchanged throughout the stream. No development or future stream observations.
loss_scale.motion_groups: For velocity and body-rate separately, s_g[h]=max(sqrt(mean_windows(sum_axes((origin_g-target_g[h])^2))), 0.01*max(sqrt(mean_windows(sum_axes((origin_g-mean_origin_g)^2))),1e-4)). Use raw bootstrap origins, not componentwise-clipped state_scale.
loss_scale.rotation_group: Same formula on the 3x3 rotation entries, multiplying squared Frobenius sums by 1/2 before square roots. This measures chordal rotation distance with small-angle radian units. The spread uses the raw mean rotation matrix as a Euclidean center, with the same factor1/2.
loss_scale.stored_array: Retain (horizon,15) scale shape: repeat s_velocity three times, s_rate three times and sqrt(2)*s_rotation nine times. Loader recomputes it from bootstrap windows exactly.
loss_scale.scope_limit: The radial data objective and its scales are invariant under common orthogonal frame rotations. The new axis-domain curvature prior and combined objective are not claimed to share this invariance. The axis-normalized supported model itself is not claimed to be rotationally equivariant. Entirely unexcited groups may still have small scales.

curvature_prior.head: Only the explicit upper-triangular quadratic current-feature head, not the full recurrent dynamics Hessian. Let Q[ij,o] be its stored coefficient; physical head coefficient is Q*output_scale[o]/quadratic_scale[ij].
curvature_prior.measured_domain: Compute once per proposal from completed measured caches and immutable raw norms. States=concat(past_states,future_states[:,:-1]); commands=concat(past_inputs,future_inputs). Eligible positions t>=delay, with the same equal role/window/time weights as conditioning. No predicted states, extra observations or simulator data.
curvature_prior.domain_factors: For first six supported normalized motion features, D=max(1,role-balanced RMS). For three normalized gravity coordinates, D=1/body_scale[6:9], using known unit-vector geometry. For issued commands, D=max(1,role-balanced RMS((issued-input_mean)/input_scale)); copy that ordered vector to the filtered-command coordinates. D does not depend on learned tau, filter state or mutable feature/quadratic/output scales.
curvature_prior.hessian_factors: c_ii=2 and c_ij=sqrt(2) for i<j. Let s_o=scale[0,:6], the fixed bootstrap velocity/rate group scales. k[ij,o]=c_ij*D_i*D_j*dt_s*output_scale[o]/(quadratic_scale[ij]*s_o).
curvature_prior.penalty: P(Q)=0.01/4*sum((k*Q)^2). Equivalently P(theta)=0.5*theta.T A theta, where A_Q=0.01/2*k^2 and every other parameter diagonal is zero. The denominator reflects the two acceleration output groups; do not average by feature count.
curvature_prior.coordinates: Physical head coefficients and prior values are exactly invariant under compensated v4 reconditioning. Complete optimizer invariance is not claimed: isotropic damping and truncated PCG remain coordinate dependent.
curvature_prior.limits: Penalizes all explicit quadratic curvature, not specifically unidentified directions. Delayed-linear, supported-motion and neural/memory nonlinearities remain. Ambient gravity Hessian includes off-sphere radial extension: a simple-extension preference, not measured spherical curvature. Strength0.01 is an untuned engineering choice reused numerically from initialization, not statistical calibration or optimality.
curvature_prior.endpoint_diagnostics: After measured case timing, save initial/final cache predictions and separately report data loss, prior loss and combined loss. Recompute components without fitting from saved predictions, session caches, raw norms, scales and coefficients using independent NumPy arithmetic. Initial empty recent cache gives bootstrap full weight. These are endpoint diagnostics on their own caches, not a monotone trajectory or per-proposal log. Do not add model/report state, persistent optimizer arrays or consumer options.

candidate.backtracking_execution: Use one cached JIT with bounded dynamic early termination. Perform 1..5 actual trial residual evaluations; always try at least one and all five if none is accepted, including zero/invalid solve or invalid conditioning. A nonfinite full-step trial must not disqualify a finite fixed direction whose shorter trial succeeds. Retain the last trial scalars on total rejection. Conditioning validity gates selection inside the private proposal. No applied intermediate trial, gradient rebuild, second direction or stream-sized storage.

proposal_evidence.storage: Bounded last_proposal in report and session metadata, None before any observation. No parameter-sized diagnostic array and no consumer option. Session archive version becomes glassbox-online-fit-v8; immutable model archives remain unchanged. Older session formats are not silently migrated.
proposal_evidence.schema: current_loss, conditioning_finite, direction_finite, trust_shrink, trials list of 1..5 {alpha,loss,predicted_reduction,finite}, selected_alpha (0 on rejection), trial_evaluations (len(trials)). Nonfinite numeric evidence is JSON null; attempted entries are never omitted.
proposal_evidence.finite_semantics: direction_finite describes fixed solve/linearization/trusted direction/current objective validity; conditioning_finite is separate. Each trial.finite describes numerical validity of that trial parameters/residual/loss/prediction, excluding the two header flags. Acceptance combines both headers and trial.finite with strict loss decrease, positive predicted reduction and gain>=.1. As in original code, there is no extra post-gain finiteness gate.
proposal_evidence.verification: Persist and validate schema, exact alpha prefix, first acceptable selection or all-five rejection, finite implications, cumulative objective bounds, and final-step accounting on save/load. The evaluator retains this evidence in its durable post-observation journal, derives per-row trial count/selected alpha, verifies counter deltas and damping/rollback once, and summarizes actual work. Scalar replay checks the recorded decision, not independent rederivation of each model loss.

quad.source: New Crazyflow Throw recordings using the pinned original pass6 behavior policy, not the candidate.
quad.release: Canonical release for all cases; only arm ratio varies. Change affects mixing and inertia, not mass/motors.
quad.plant: CrazyflowPlantConfig(control_frequency_hz=100), default cf21B_500, rng_seed0. Ten-second limit, original first-second no actuation, first-floor termination; retain failures/truncation.

fixedwing.source: Known reserved Cascade Skywalker-X8 recordings; cold prefix-only fitting. Not a blind benchmark.

learner_visibility: Canonical15 motion from observed NWU/FLU rigid-body states, timestamps, ordered issued commands and their units, opaque configuration identity. Exclude actuator telemetry, plant coefficients, layout, wind and simulator hidden state. Old collection controller may use applied motor telemetry; this is a behavior-policy limitation, not candidate input.

comparison.baseline: Primary: authenticated saved v6 online predictions on bitwise-identical inputs, origins, times and truth. Initial core arrays, frozen predictions and kinematic predictions must match exactly. Keep frozen-prefix and kinematic diagnostics.
comparison.order: For command at row k, save candidate and frozen predictions and candidate model fingerprint before revealing state[k+1]. Score target, then assimilate it exactly once. No fitting on full-stream arrays.
comparison.primary: One-step velocity vector RMSE (m/s) and body-rate vector RMSE (rad/s), over every scored transition in each stream. Save all component residuals.
comparison.secondary: SO(3) geodesic RMSE (rad); post-change windows0-1s and1s-end separately; prefix command span/rank and fixed-scale support excursions.
comparison.aggregation: Geometric mean candidate/v6 velocity and rate RMSE ratios, denominator floor1e-9; equal cases within family and equal family weights. No individual-case veto. Preserve all scored rows including the floor-truncated tape.
comparison.long_horizon: Not a primary claim in this iteration; no use of unknown future behavior-policy commands as online forecasts.
comparison.kinematic_diagnostic: Also score a no-fit baseline holding current world velocity and body-rate while integrating orientation with that body-rate over the sample interval. Report its physical errors and candidate/kinematic ratios. This is a declared absolute-accuracy sanity check, not a change to the frozen primary acceptance gate.
comparison.incumbent_limit: The old Throw identifier uses measured applied rotor telemetry and is not a matched-input baseline. This experiment does not establish superiority over that identifier or a controller recovery result.
comparison.previous_candidate: Adopted v6 remains the sole primary comparator. V7 is not the optimizer baseline or the chosen prior. No startup-only or weaker historical reference replaces v6.
comparison.tail_diagnostics: For every case and candidate/reference/frozen/kinematic arm, save/recompute velocity norm, rate norm and SO(3) angle median,p95,p99,max, largest-five squared-error share, and RMS of the largest ceil(0.1*N) errors selected independently per arm. No sample is removed from primary scoring.
comparison.rotation_rate_diagnostic: For origin R0,w0 and a next state R1,w1, define d=Log(R0.T@R1)/dt-0.5*(w0+w1) using the principal SO(3) rotation vector with proper-rotation projection for rounded predictions. Report RMS norm of d_prediction-d_truth and each raw defect. This is a descriptive sampled-data surrogate; actual nonlinear angular motion is not assumed trapezoidal or zero-defect, and angle aliasing remains a limitation.

acceptance.accuracy: Keep the existing primary gate prospectively against v6: equal-family velocity/rate aggregate<=0.8, each family aggregate<1, all cases finite/complete. Report every regression; no individual case veto.
acceptance.causality: Preserve causal ingestion, initialization, coordinate compensation, v6 physical prior, fixed loss scales, bounded caches, rollback and save/resume tests. Independent analytic tests cover 16-PCG direction arithmetic with nonzero prior, damping exclusion, early first-pass backtracking rather than best loss, nonfinite full step rescued by shortening, all-five rejection/zero gradient, actual forward call counts, invalid conditioning, original gain/damping thresholds and archive/evidence tamper rejection.
acceptance.preservation: All 14 package files other than online.py must remain byte-identical to adopted v6. Existing applicable tests and exact saved offline/Dart baseline replay must pass. The old four-step-only current-module reconstruction test is superseded by v8 proposal/rollback tests; historical v6 audit source and evidence stay pinned in Git/artifacts. Do not modify model archive contract or inference.
acceptance.runtime: Record synchronized cold startup/first update and warmed median/p95/max prediction and observe latency, with initialization/checkpoint/journal overhead separately excluded as before. p95 observe<=sample interval remains a separate real-time target. Report actual per-update trial count, selected alpha, objective totals, scheduled CG/curvature counts and rejected steps. Do not infer latency from the bounded budget or from historical replay timing alone.
acceptance.recovery: Out of scope: replay success is not successful candidate-controlled recovery.
acceptance.gap_qualification: Separate robustness flag, not a rewrite of the primary adoption gate: equal-family upper-decile velocity/rate ratio<1, equal-family orientation RMSE ratio<=1, and equal-family truth-relative rotation/rate-defect RMSE ratio<1. Report each independently, all family/case values, quantiles and maxima. Concentration and maximum errors are descriptive.

evidence: Commit this protocol before implementation and completed scientific source before fitting. Authenticate adopted v6 and nested v4/v2 evidence into an exclusive v8 pack. Score all3137 targets before revealing and assimilating each exactly once across all six unchanged tapes, including truncated quad135. Initial core arrays and frozen/kinematic predictions must match v6 exactly. Keep failures and all regressions; one candidate, no hyperparameter sweep. Verify all saved pairs, causal journals, compact proposal evidence, captures, endpoint data/prior losses, metrics and gates without fitting. Independent NumPy/SciPy audit must not invoke Glassbox/JAX model or optimizer calls. Historical audit tools are reproducible in their pinned scientific checkouts.

rationale.relationship: First-acceptable shortening made all46 saved longer directions acceptable and beat the original four-step retained loss in34, versus11 unshortened. Twelve selections still lost. Original four already accepted46/46. These are selected fixed-wing training snapshots with42 capped128-step directions, not proof about16-step directions, quads, prediction gains, convergence or a practical online budget. This candidate tests the hypothesis on full causal trajectories.

causal_captures.capture: Save full session before selected prediction and before target reveal, outside timed predict/observe calls. Save actual prediction context/history/issued command, origin, recorded float32 prediction and truth only after prediction. Require saving not to change session fingerprint. Existing v6-selected rows remain fixed regardless of candidate outcomes.
causal_captures.verification: Authenticate saved sessions and context against each scored before fingerprint, cursor/counters, real tape history/commands, issued command, recorded prediction and truth using saved arrays only, no fitting or model calls. Require all23 on successful full evaluation.
causal_captures.analysis: Preserve the same23 prospective pre-prediction snapshots for future diagnosis and verify their identity from arrays. Do not run head/Jacobian/integration-refinement diagnostics in this iteration; primary work is the full forecast/cost comparison.
